Messages.Author: Alan Kwan
Messages.Body:
Is the current ruling on Brainwash that I can't transfer off from
a Brainwashed vampire?

What's the rationale of this errata? This seems to be against the
WotC policy of issuing (in other cases, often well-deserved)
erratas. This one seems completely unnecessary to me. No
one has ever complained that a Brainwash is `wallpaper' or
`too costly to play' if blood cannot be taken off, that I've
heard of.

--
"Live Life with Heart."

Alan Kwan kw...@cs.cornell.edu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
kw...@cs.cornell.edu (Alan Kwan) writes:
>Is the current ruling on Brainwash that I can't transfer off from
>a Brainwashed vampire? What's the rationale of this errata?

It isn't errata. It's clarification.

All transfers are made "to" a vampire. Sometimes this moves a blood to
the vampire, sometimes it can be used to move a blood from the vampire.

Brainwash:
You can't make any transfers to the vampire. It takes one tranfer _to_
the vampire to transfer a blood to him, and it takes two transfers _to_
the vampire to transfer a blood from him.

Since many people refer to spending transfers to a vampire to move blood back
to one's own pool as a "transfer from the vampire", the DT cleared things up.
